Provide close-up photos of lens front and rear glass under bright light (scratches/fungus/haze) and a sample high-contrast photo.
Show all included accessories laid out (battery, charger, caps, strap, cables, manuals) and confirm whether an SD card is included.
Provide full inspection photos of the camera body (front/back/sides/bottom) and lens mount for any damage/repairs.
Show camera menu screen with firmware version and confirm SD card detection (or state none included).
Demonstrate battery performance (battery level drop during a short test) or confirm battery model and condition.
